notes: Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS. Primary product is in-app insights chat and search using embeddings. Currently on multi-cloud infra but must keep EU customer data in EU.
Use-case specifics: in-product assistant (context window ~8k tokens), semantic search over docs (5M vectors target), support triage reranking for SLA-sensitive tickets.
Latency & throughput: product team wants 95th <120ms for short-turn chat flows; OK with slightly higher for long-form generation. Target baseline 15-25 QPS per region during peak.
Cost sensitivity: finance looking for committed pricing to bring down per-token cost; goal ARR contribution target to justify Dedicated commit.

Deployment discussion notes: prefer Hosted API to start for time-to-market; evaluating Dedicated in EU for data residency and predictable throughput. key ask: automated multi-region routing that keeps PII in EU while allowing failover inside EU only.
Customer quote: 'We can’t have backups leaving the EU — that alone will push us to Dedicated or Private.' — Marta Novak (VP Product)
Security: legal insists on SSO + audit logs + KMS integration. ISO27001 certification would be a strong enabler; SOC2 acceptable but want explicit encryption-at-rest key control in EU.

POC scope (draft): 4 weeks, validate hosted flow for dev + dedicated EU-only config for perf & residency; run embedding indexing of ~5M vectors, 72h continuous QPS test from Frankfurt and Dublin with 95/99 P50/P95 targets, measure token cost over sample workload.

Technical risk notes: multi-region routing tradeoff flagged — want route-by-source-region within EU, but worried about cross-region replication for index and KV cache. SE to propose caching strategy that preserves residency (replicate metadata only inside EU regions).
Operational notes: infra wants simple network onboarding (AWS peering or PrivateLink), minimal firewall exceptions. Luca asked for infra diagram and a list of outbound endpoints for legal review.
Next immediate actions: send SOW draft + POC success criteria; provide EU-only deployment diagram; quote for Dedicated 3-region commit vs single-region with burst capacity.
